title: Customer-Pay Repairs Vehicle Exclusivity: Open Repair Orders on One Vehicle
content:
## Rule

A vehicle may have at most the tier's limit of open customer-pay repair orders per vehicle (a limit of 1 in every Customer-Pay Repairs tier) open at once, where open means any status other than closed or cancelled. The vehicle has no open customer-pay repair order and no open insurance claim repair order. An insurance claim repair order is open in any status other than closed, cancelled or total loss. Customer-pay work wanted on a vehicle that is in an open claim repair is added to that claim repair order as a customer-pay addition, never opened here; work wanted on a vehicle with an open customer-pay repair order is handled as additional work on it.

## Condition for opening a Customer-Pay Repairs repair order

> The vehicle has no open customer-pay repair order and no open insurance claim repair order.

- **When it applies**: when a Customer-Pay Repairs repair order is opened for the vehicle.
- **What decides it**: the system records, checked before the order is opened: the vehicle's Customer-Pay Repairs repair orders with their statuses and the vehicle's Insurance Claim Repairs repair orders with their statuses. A customer's own account of what is or is not open does not replace those records.
- **Which records count**: only repair orders on the same vehicle as the one the new order would be opened for.

## Which statuses are open

| Record on the same vehicle | Status | Open for this rule |
|---|---|---|
| Customer-Pay Repairs repair order | opened, in repair, awaiting approval, ready, delivered | Yes |
| Customer-Pay Repairs repair order | closed, cancelled | No |
| Insurance Claim Repairs repair order | closed, cancelled, total loss | No |
| Insurance Claim Repairs repair order | any other status | Yes |

A delivered Customer-Pay Repairs order is still open until it is closed.

## Combinations

| Open customer-pay order on the vehicle | Open insurance claim repair order on the vehicle | Condition | What the rule says about the work wanted |
|---|---|---|---|
| No | No | Met | This condition does not bar opening a Customer-Pay Repairs repair order. |
| No | Yes | Not met | The customer-pay work is added to that claim repair order as a customer-pay addition, never opened here. |
| Yes | No | Not met | The work is handled as additional work on the open customer-pay repair order. |

## Cases (hypothetical)

- The vehicle's only Customer-Pay Repairs order is cancelled and its only Insurance Claim Repairs order was declared a total loss: neither is open, and the condition is met.
- The vehicle's Customer-Pay Repairs order shows delivered but not closed: it is open, and the condition is not met.
